instruction: I want Chrome to ask before allowing sites to access my camera. Can you set this up?

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to set camera permission to 'Ask'. The getter reads Chrome Preferences to verify profile.default_content_setting_values.media_stream_camera is 3 (ASK) or not set to 1 (ALLOW).

llm_judge_reasons: Core verification logic is correct: getter properly reads Chrome Preferences file and checks camera permission setting
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure Preferences file reflects current state (pkill + relaunch + sleep)
Metric (exact_match) correctly compares getter result against expected value 'true'
Expected value semantically correct: 'true' means camera is set to 'Ask'
Getter correctly handles value 0 (default/ask) and not-set cases (defaults to 0)
Instruction coverage complete: single requirement (camera ask permission) verified by single check

Minor issue: Getter includes value 3 in the 'ask' check, but Chrome's standard camera permission values are 0 (default/ask), 1 (allow), 2 (block). Value 3 is not documented as a standard camera permission setting and may be erroneous or platform-specific
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Verify if value 3 is actually used for camera permissions in any Chrome version/platform, or remove it from the check (line 38 in chrome.py)
If value 3 is not valid, simplify the return statement to: return 'true' if camera_setting in [0] or camera_setting is None else 'false'
Add comment explaining why value 3 is included if it's a platform-specific behavior
